permissions.purpose: Link the recognized person's Amazon account with profile:user_id and compare it with the enrolled owner.
permissions.deniedBehavior: Make no vehicle request. Return the account-linking card and direct the owner to skill Settings in the Alexa app.

permissions.purpose: Use Skills Personalization and the recognized person's linked token to authorize voice requests.
permissions.deniedBehavior: Reject vehicle requests without a recognized, approved, linked person. Explain the voice ID and skill personalization Settings prerequisites; do not substitute the device account.

permissions.purpose: Honor the owner's explicit application consent to access and control the enrolled vehicle.
permissions.deniedBehavior: Make no vehicle request. Direct the owner to the web or mobile application Settings to review vehicle consent.

permissions.purpose: Honor the owner's separate optional consent for scheduled vehicle location collection.
permissions.deniedBehavior: Keep scheduled collection paused. Do not infer tracking consent from skill enablement or account linking; direct the owner to application Settings.
